evidence.detail: Reviewed TradingPostPacketHandler (ScriptPacket 30) constructs rs/s/t/c for live account listings, populates item id, sold/amount values, price, currency and item name, then passes the record directly into reviewed TradingPostListingsPanel.

Reviewed TradingPostSearchPanel constructs the same rs/s/t/c type from exact sale-history JSON keys id, item_id, time, item_name, seller, buyer, currency, price and amount, then renders those records as TradingPostSearchResultPanel rows.

Reviewed TradingPostListingPanel accepts rs/s/t/c and renders item name/image, sold-versus-amount state, currency icon, 'Price each:' and 'Received:' values, using the record's amount/price/currency fields and total-value product.

The record resolves a fallback item name from the exact item definition using its item-id field, and both account-listing and search-history presentation use that same item id to obtain the TradingPostPlugin image.
rs/s/t/c contains only listing data with getters/setters plus one total-value calculation; it has no UI, network, plugin lifecycle or unrelated gameplay responsibility.

proposals.note: TradingPostListing is fixed by two independent producers—ScriptPacket 30 live listings and TradingPostSearchPanel sale-history JSON—and by the reviewed listing/search-result consumers. The model deliberately spans both active account listings and historical search results. Confidence is 0.999.
